hero.lede: Since 2016 we have been guiding executives, heirs and families through the lasting organisation of their private information. Here is how.

freedom.heading: Tomorrow's estate is also an estate of data.

body.lead: Digital acceleration is transforming the way each of us receives, keeps and transmits private information. Advisors produce data they keep on their own systems. The client rarely truly owns it.
body.rest: Proxy Papers puts that ownership back where it belongs: with you, under your control, in a reliable framework.

cards.title: Never wait on an advisor again.
cards.desc: You no longer depend on anyone to retrieve a document about yourself.

steps.lede: The same dedicated advisor stays with you from the first meeting to the annual review. No rotating teams, no subcontracting.

engagement.title: The discovery meeting
engagement.desc: We understand your situation, you ask us anything, and together we decide whether there is a fit.

engagement.title: The onboarding audit
engagement.desc: We map your sources, advisors, deadlines and volume. You receive a costed action plan and a proposal.

items.name: Onboarding
items.desc: We collect, sort and classify all your existing documents, backed up on your Papers Box, hosted in France. By the end, you know where everything is.

items.name: Organization
items.desc: We structure folders by theme, open secure sharing with your advisors, and set deadline alerts. The framework is in place.

items.name: Follow-up
items.desc: Regular updates and periodic on-site visits, monthly or quarterly. Your file stays alive, never frozen.

items.name: Support
items.desc: For your projects — purchase, sale, donation, estate, tax — we transmit the right items to the right advisor at the right time.

items.name: Management
items.desc: Real-time visibility on your Papers Box, periodic report with decision-support insights. You regain control, with full clarity.
